about.name: I'm {name}
about.bio1: I am a product designer and FE developer based in Ho Chi Minh City, specializing in crafting end-to-end digital products - from user research and UI/UX design to building fully functional.
about.bio2: I also leverage AI-powered vibe coding to build browser extensions and productivity tools that streamline my daily workflow. This allows me to turn ideas into working solutions at speed, bridging the gap between design thinking and engineering execution.

newsdigest.title: NewsDigest
newsdigest.description: AI-powered daily tech news aggregator with Gemini AI summarization.
newsdigest.text1: A personal project built entirely on free-tier infrastructure -Cloudflare Workers, Pages, KV, and Google's Gemini API. It automatically scrapes articles from RSS, Reddit, YouTube, Hacker News, and GitHub Trending on a cron schedule, then summarizes and scores each piece using Gemini AI via Cloudflare AI Gateway.
newsdigest.text2: The design is deliberately utilitarian -no visual clutter, no unnecessary chrome. Every element serves the single goal of absorbing information as fast as possible. On mobile, news details expand and collapse with a natural swipe gesture, keeping the reading flow uninterrupted and intuitive.

summarizer.title: Summarizerrrr
summarizer.description: Browser extension for summarizing web pages, youtube videos, Udemy, Coursera.
summarizer.text1: Summarizerrrr isn't just another wrapper -it's a free and open-source productivity tool built with data ownership in mind. Users have full control over their information: choose any API provider you trust, or run a local LLM for complete privacy. Whether you're researching, learning a new skill, or just trying to get the gist of a long video, Summarizerrrr has you covered. The UI is designed for comfortable reading and easy navigation through long content.
summarizer.text2: The extension is designed to work seamlessly across platforms -from iOS and Android to desktop browsers that support side panels, as well as those that don't, like Arc and Safari. Each environment gets a tailored experience that feels native, not compromised.

tam_anh.title: Tam Anh Hospital
tam_anh.description: Internal systems, digital interfaces, and healthcare UX improvements.
tam_anh.text1: At Tam Anh General Hospital, I designed and developed digital interface systems that support internal operations and elevate the patient experience. Depending on each development team's tech stack, I adapted to the appropriate languages and libraries -leveraging existing templates and component systems to accelerate delivery and maintain consistency across projects.
tam_anh.text2: The visual language is bright, clean, and clinical -every element is paired with clear labeling and intuitive icons to guide users effortlessly. Layouts are designed to maximize screen real estate, ensuring all critical information is visible at a glance without unnecessary scrolling.
tam_anh.text3: For the QMS (Queue Management System) displays, I went beyond static design -collaborating with the dev team to implement continuous-loop animations using pure CSS instead of JavaScript, ensuring smooth, uninterrupted motion with optimal rendering performance.
